tagline: Four bolstered sides, so whichever way they turn, an edge is there.
lead: Your dog gets an edge on every side to lean into, around a soft fibre-filled base.
value: Fibre cushioning in the base and all four walls, a non-slip base for smooth floors, and a cover that washes at 30°C.
intro: Sparrow is a four-sided bolster dog bed with soft fibre filling in both the base and the walls, a non-slip base and a zipped cover that washes at 30°C. Four sizes, Small to XL.
points: Four bolsters frame the resting area, so there's always something to lean on.
Fibre filling cushions both the base and the walls.
The non-slip base helps it stay put on smooth flooring.
Small to XL, so you can choose around their real sleeping space.
best_for: Dogs who settle by leaning into something and like an edge around the whole bed, with a soft-filled base.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The four bolsters take up part of the footprint, so compare with the space inside them. If a measurement is unclear, ask us.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Four-Sided Bolster Dog Bed, Small to XL | Snoozly
seo_description: An edge on every side for dogs who like to lean. Four-sided bolster dog bed with soft fibre filling, non-slip base and 30°C washable cover. Small to XL.
